svg.title: How to apply press-on nails
svg.desc: Four photographic examples: cleaning a natural nail, dry-fitting a press-on, adding adhesive, and pressing into place.

g.text: A few simple steps for a beautiful fit.
Clean, lightly buff and wipe dry.
Try each tip before using adhesive.
Choose jelly tabs or nail glue.
Align at the cuticle. Press firmly.
Follow your adhesive label for hold time, aftercare and removal.
